```{r}
sp_clean <- spotify_data[!is.na(spotify_data$track_album_name), ]
cols_to_remove <- c("track_id", "track_href", "uri", "analysis_url", "id", 
                    "playlist_id", "type", "track_album_id", "key", "mode","time_signature")

sp_clean <- sp_clean[ , !(names(sp_clean) %in% cols_to_remove)]
sp_clean$track_popularity <- as.numeric(sp_clean$track_popularity)
sp_clean$duration_ms <- as.numeric(sp_clean$duration_ms)
names(sp_clean)
```

```{r}
sapply(sp_clean, class)
```

```{r}

top_5_genres <- sp_clean %>%
  count(playlist_genre, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(playlist_genre)


filtered_data <- sp_clean %>%
  filter(playlist_genre %in% top_5_genres)

top_5_subgenres <- filtered_data %>%
  count(playlist_subgenre, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(playlist_subgenre)

sp_filtered <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(playlist_subgenre %in% top_5_subgenres)
dim(sp_filtered)
```


```{r}
spotify_data_numeric <- sp_filtered[, sapply(sp_filtered, is.numeric)]
faces(spotify_data_numeric[1:9,],face.type=0, main = "Chernoff Faces - Tipo 0")
faces(spotify_data_numeric[1:9,],face.type=1, main = "Chernoff Faces - Tipo 1")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## PCA

```{r}
sp_filtered$playlist_genre <- factor(sp_filtered$playlist_genre)
sp_filtered$playlist_subgenre <- factor(sp_filtered$playlist_subgenre)
# Lista de columnas numéricas
numeric_vars <- c("energy", "tempo", "danceability", "loudness", "liveness", 
                  "valence", "speechiness", "instrumentalness",
                  "duration_ms", "acousticness", 
                  "track_popularity")
categorical_indices <- which(names(sp_filtered) %in% c("playlist_genre", "playlist_subgenre", "track_artist", "playlist_name", "track_album_name", "track_name", "track_album_release_date"))
summary(sp_filtered)
```

```{r}
spotify_pca <- PCA(sp_filtered,
                   quali.sup = categorical_indices,
                   graph = FALSE)
summary(spotify_pca)
```

```{r}
spotify_pca$eig
```
 
```{r}

var_explicada <- spotify_pca$eig[,2]  

df <- data.frame(Componente = seq_along(var_explicada), Varianza = var_explicada)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Componente, y = Varianza)) +
  geom_point(color="blue", size=3) +
  geom_line(color="blue") +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", 
       x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Proportion of Variance Explained") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
calculate_KMO <- function(x) {
  x <- subset(x, complete.cases(x))       
  r <- cor(x)                             
  r2 <- r^2                               
  i <- solve(r)                           
  d <- diag(i)                            
  p2 <- (-i / sqrt(outer(d, d)))^2        
  diag(r2) <- diag(p2) <- 0               
  KMO <- sum(r2) / (sum(r2) + sum(p2))    
  MSA <- colSums(r2) / (colSums(r2) + colSums(p2))  
  return(list(KMO = KMO, MSA = MSA))
}

kmo_result <- calculate_KMO(sp_filtered_numeric)

cat("KMO global:", round(kmo_result$KMO, 3), "\n")

print(round(kmo_result$MSA, 3))
```

```{r}
ind_coords <- get_pca_ind(spotify_pca)$coord[, 1:4]

pca_with_genre <- data.frame(
  Dim1 = ind_coords[, 1],
  Dim2 = ind_coords[, 2], 
  Dim3 = ind_coords[, 3],
  Dim4 = ind_coords[, 4],
  playlist_genre = sp_filtered$playlist_genre,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

str(pca_with_genre)

genre_stats <- pca_with_genre %>%
  group_by(playlist_genre) %>%
  summarise(
    Dim1_mean = mean(Dim1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim1_sd   = sd(Dim1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim2_mean = mean(Dim2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim2_sd   = sd(Dim2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim3_mean = mean(Dim3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim3_sd   = sd(Dim3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim4_mean = mean(Dim4, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim4_sd   = sd(Dim4, na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    .groups   = 'drop'
  )

print("Estadístiques per gènere:")
print(genre_stats)
```

```{r}
if(require(plotly, quietly = TRUE)) {
  
  pca_3d_data <- data.frame(
    Dim1 = ind_coords[, 1],
    Dim2 = ind_coords[, 2],
    Dim3 = ind_coords[, 3],
    Genre = sp_filtered$playlist_genre,
    Artist = sp_filtered$track_artist,
    Song = sp_filtered$track_name
  )
  
  set.seed(123)
  sample_idx <- sample(nrow(pca_3d_data), min(1000, nrow(pca_3d_data)))
  pca_3d_sample <- pca_3d_data[sample_idx, ]
  
  p_3d <- plot_ly(pca_3d_sample, 
                  x = ~Dim1, y = ~Dim2, z = ~Dim3,
                  color = ~Genre,
                  text = ~paste("Artista:", Artist, "<br>Canción:", Song),
                  type = "scatter3d",
                  mode = "markers",
                  marker = list(size = 3)) %>%
    layout(title = "PCA 3D - Canciones por Género",
           scene = list(
             xaxis = list(title = "Dim 1 (Energía vs Acústica)"),
             yaxis = list(title = "Dim 2 (Bailabilidad)"),
             zaxis = list(title = "Dim 3 (Popularidad vs Experimental)")
           ))
  
  print(p_3d)
}
```


## MDS 
```{r}
sp_filtered_numeric <- sp_filtered[sapply(sp_filtered, is.numeric)]

cor_matrix <- cor(sp_filtered_numeric)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", 
         order = "hclust", tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45,
         title = "Matriz de Correlaciones - Variables Numéricas")
```

Decidirem eliminar un seguit de variables i escalarem les que ens quedem
```{r}
vars_to_remove <- c("energy", "liveness", "loudness", "acousticness", 
                   "instrumentalness", "duration_ms")
mds_data <- (sp_filtered_numeric[, !names(sp_filtered_numeric) %in% vars_to_remove])
mds_data_scaled <- scale(mds_data)
mds_data_final <- unique(mds_data_scaled)
mds_data_final <- as.data.frame(mds_data_final)
cat("\nDimensiones después del preprocesamiento:")
cat("\n- Observaciones originales:", nrow(sp_filtered_numeric))
cat("\n- Observaciones después de eliminar duplicados:", nrow(mds_data_final))
cat("\n- Variables finales:", ncol(mds_data_final))
cat("\n- Variables finales:", paste(names(mds_data_final), collapse = ", "))
```

```{r}
dist_euclidean <- dist(mds_data_final, method = "euclidean")

mds_data_gower = sp_filtered[, c("playlist_genre", names(sp_filtered)[sapply(sp_filtered, is.numeric)])]
mds_data_gower$playlist_genre <- as.factor(mds_data_gower$playlist_genre)
gower_dist <- daisy(mds_data_gower, metric = "gower")
```

```{r}
mds_metric <- cmdscale(dist_euclidean, eig = TRUE)

eigenvalues <- mds_metric$eig
positive_eig <- eigenvalues[eigenvalues > 0]
gof_2d <- sum(positive_eig[1:2]) / sum(positive_eig)
```

```{r}
coords_mds <- mds_metric$points[, 1:2]
colnames(coords_mds) <- c("MDS1", "MDS2")

track_names <- as.character(sp_filtered$track_name)

plot(coords_mds[,1], coords_mds[,2], 
     xlab = "Coordinate 1", 
     ylab = "Coordinate 2", 
     main = "Metric MDS - Euclidean (Songs)", 
     type = "n")

points(coords_mds[,1], coords_mds[,2], pch = 19, col = "black", cex = 0.5)

text(coords_mds[,1], coords_mds[,2], labels = track_names, cex = 0.6, pos = 3)

```

```{r}
colors <- as.factor(sp_filtered$playlist_genre)
palette <- rainbow(length(unique(colors)))
plot(coords_mds, type = "n", main = "MDS by genre")
text(coords_mds, labels = track_names, col = palette[colors], cex = 0.6)

legend("topright", legend = levels(colors), col = palette, pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
```

```{r}
top_200_idx <- order(sp_filtered$track_popularity, decreasing = TRUE)[1:200]

x_top200 <- coords_mds[top_200_idx]

track_names_top200 <- make.unique(as.character(sp_filtered$track_name[top_200_idx]))
colors_top200 <- as.factor(sp_filtered$playlist_genre[top_200_idx])
palette_top200 <- rainbow(length(levels(colors_top200)))

plot(x_top200, type = "n", main = "Top 200 cançons més populars")
text(x_top200, labels = track_names_top200,
     col = palette_top200[as.numeric(colors_top200)], cex = 0.7)
legend("topright", legend = levels(colors), col = palette, pch = 16, cex = 0.5)

```

```{r}
original_vars <- list(tempo = sp_filtered$tempo, 
                      danceability = sp_filtered$danceability, 
                      valence = sp_filtered$valence, 
                      speechiness = sp_filtered$speechiness, 
                      track_popularity = sp_filtered$track_popularity)

par(mfrow = c(2, 3))

for (var in names(original_vars)) {
  var_values <- original_vars[[var]]
  colors_var <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
  color_indices <- cut(var_values, breaks = 100, labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  plot(coords_df$MDS1, coords_df$MDS2,
       col = colors_var[color_indices], pch = 16, cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "MDS Dimension 1", ylab = "MDS Dimension 2",
       main = paste("MDS Colored by", var))
  
  legend("topright", 
         legend = c("Low", "High"),
         col = c("blue", "red"), pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
mds_gower_metric <- cmdscale(gower_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
eigv <- mds_gower_metric$eig

dims <- 1:10

gof1 <- cumsum(eigv[dims]) / sum(abs(eigv)) * 100
gof2 <- cumsum(eigv[dims]) / sum(eigv[eigv > 0]) * 100

data.frame(
  Dimensions = dims,
  GOF1 = gof1,
  GOF2 = gof2
)
```


```{r}
coords_gower <- mds_gower_metric$points[, 1:2]
colnames(coords_gower) <- c("MDS1", "MDS2")

plot(coords_gower[,1], coords_gower[,2],
     xlab = "Coordenada 1",
     ylab = "Coordenada 2",
     main = "MDS amb distància Gower",
     col = "black",
     pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
text(coords_gower[,1], coords_gower[,2], labels = track_names, cex = 0.6)
```


```{r}
colors <- as.factor(sp_filtered$playlist_genre)
palette <- rainbow(length(unique(colors)))
plot(coords_gower, type = "n", main = "MDS with gower distance by genre")
text(coords_gower, labels = track_names, col = palette[colors], cex = 0.6)

legend("topright", legend = levels(colors), col = palette, pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
sp_nmds <- isoMDS(dist_euclidean)
cat("Stress del MDS no-mètric:", round(sp_nmds$stress, 4))
```

```{r}
nmds_coords <- sp_nmds$points
colnames(nmds_coords) <- c("NMDS1", "NMDS2")

plot(nmds_coords[, 1], nmds_coords[, 2],
     xlab = "NMDS Dimensió 1", ylab = "NMDS Dimensió 2",
     main = paste("MDS No Métric (Stress =", round(sp_nmds$stress, 3), ")"),
     type = "n")
text(nmds_coords[, 1], nmds_coords[, 2], 
     labels = make.unique(track_names), 
     cex = 0.6, col = "darkgreen")
```

```{r}
spotify_shepard <- Shepard(dist_euclidean, sp_nmds$points)

plot(spotify_shepard, pch = ".", main = "Shepard plot - NMDS")
lines(spotify_shepard$x, spotify_shepard$yf, type = "S")
```
